task_definition.title: W10-ι: B+H supervision composition integration gate (deterministic self-restart deploy crash→named-phase recovery)
task_definition.description:
Stream W10 (harness-supervision), PRD plans/harness-supervision-prd.md §7 boundary sketch, manifest §ι (LEAF, C-as-integration-gate). The G5 two-way boundary artifact roping proc_supervision + DeployState + TaskGroundTruth + BackgroundService together — the 2064/2105/1900/2059/2066 incident chain as ONE green test.

Implement the composition boundary suite (real producer + real consumer across seams; crashes simulated by injected fault points, not real process kills):
- D1 (RestartPlan × DeployState × TaskGroundTruth): drive a deterministic self-restart deploy through `RestartPlan.execute()` (own-unit self-restart cell), inject a fault after the `ran` phase write, restart, and assert `TaskGroundTruth.derive_truth` sees `deploy_phase==ran` (a NAMED state) → `_RECOVERY` yields the defined action, NOT phantom-done; then a cross-unit blocking-verify cell (RP-4/RP-5) reaches `verified→done`.
- R3 (2064 cell) + R2 (2105 cell): the RestartPlan matrix — unset ORCH_UNIT self-target REFUSES+escalates (no self-kill); relative-script cell carries --working-directory + absolute script.
- S1: the registry shutdown-order test with an injected wedging BackgroundService completes stop_all() bounded (no hang).
- G1: a stranded task with a landed-outbox journal row is recovered to done{merged,sha} journal-first.

Observable signal: the composition suite (D1 + R3 + R4 + S1 + G1) is GREEN in CI — a deterministic self-restart deploy crashed mid-phase recovers to the correct named DeployState phase + classified recovery action, with the restart matrix and shutdown-order green. This is an end-to-end integration gate exercising the real RestartPlan/DeployState/TaskGroundTruth/LifecycleRegistry across their seams (not a synthetic-input unit test).
Consumer: CI (proves the supervision stack composes before program-level deploy).
Modules: orchestrator. Depends on δ (RestartPlan delegate), ζ (DeployState writes), η (LifecycleRegistry), θ2 (sweep recovery).
